formal_statement: ∃ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ¬ (G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a)) ∧ (∀ S : Finset (Fin n), (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ S ∨ v ∈ S) → 5 ≤ S.card) ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ (∃ A : Finset ℕ, A.card ≤ 4 ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → j ∈ A) ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)
plain_statement: There are a number n, a graph on n vertices with no 4-cycle (triangles allowed) in which every vertex cover has at least 5 vertices, and a circuit of AND and OR gates of fan-in at most two (no NOT; only AND gates counted) with at most 4 AND gates that is true exactly when both ends of some edge are true. The graph is part of the witness. SEARCH ROW: no witness is known. A witness refutes the conjecture that on graphs without 4-cycles the least AND count equals the cover number (settled by search up to cover number 4, not checked); the negation is equally wanted. Conjecture either way.
title: Search: a graph without 4-cycles of cover number at least 5 whose edge function has a monotone circuit with 4 AND gates
